description:
Show the valid values of a Finance Database filter (e.g. every sector or
        country) for an asset class.

        Use this before filtering an asset class tool so the exact values are known.
        Filters narrow the options to what actually occurs, e.g. the industries of
        the 'Health Care' sector in Germany.

        Returns:
            str: Compact JSON with the values and their total count.

asset_class.description: The asset class: equities, etfs, indices, currencies or cryptos.
asset_class.title: Asset Class

filters.description: Optional filters narrowing the options, e.g. {'country': 'Netherlands'} to list only the sectors present in the Netherlands. Values may be comma-separated.
filters.title: Filters

include_delisted.description: Include values only used by delisted entries (equities and ETFs).
include_delisted.title: Include Delisted

limit.description: Maximum values to return (default 100, maximum 500); the total count is always given.
limit.title: Limit

selection.description: The filter to list the values of, e.g. 'sector', 'country', 'industry' (equities) or 'category', 'family' (ETFs). Leave empty for an overview of every filter.
selection.title: Selection

name: show_options
